units: bbox = [x, y, w, h] in % of full image, origin top-left; z = draw order within the layer (higher = on top)

screenshot.name: Wall backdrop (zoomed talent screen)

screenshot.name: Horizontal seam

screenshot.name: Lower wall (blue, halftone lower-left)

zones.name: screenshot-only
zones.region: y 0-~75 (right) / 0-~82 (left), minus logo corner and mascot

zones.name: mixed
zones.region: x 52-100, y 43-78: mascot over wall/tooltip tail

layerSeparation: Angle: all in-game UI is at 0 deg; every overlay element except the logo is tilted (-7.7 / -9.7 / -11.2 deg).
Colour: screenshot is slate/steel-blue; overlay is saturated purple, yellow and white with thick black outlines.
Outline weight: overlay shapes carry 1-1.5% black outlines; the UI uses thin outlines.
Occlusion: overlay covers the empty wall and the repetitive tree base, never the tooltip text.

readingOrder.why: largest type (94% wide, 13% tall), white on purple
mascot eye, near the lower-right thirds point
tooltip: the only in-game copy, framed by the black box on the upper-right third
node chain on the left, read top-down along the green rail
logo, top-left corner, last because it is small and low-contrast yellow on slate

composition.balance: Left column (tree) vs right block (tooltip + mascot) - a two-column split at x ~45%. Bottom third is one full-width purple slab; the headline starts at the far left to counter the mascot on the right.

angles.note: The three overlay tilts fan out (7.7 / 9.7 / 11.2) so the ledge slab narrows toward the right: a perspective wedge, not parallel bands.

headline.method: linear fit of glyph tops and bottoms (both -9.67)

measured.method: colour-threshold masks + scipy connected components on the 1242x2208 original; line angles from least-squares fits over 20+ columns; expect +/-1% on bboxes
